DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: カードの紛失について、お話を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: I will hear the details about the lost card.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 父がカードをなくしました。私は父の子ですが、父のカードを自分のカードのように届けてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 父カードの代理相談と本人届出の違いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: My father lost his card. I am his child, but may I report his card as though it were my own?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the difference between asking on your father's behalf and reporting as the account holder. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 紛失したのはお父様のカードと明確にお伝えください。ご本人は今、連絡できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please clearly state that the lost card is your father's. Can he be contacted now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 父は家にいて電話できます。私は仕事帰りに相談だけに来ました。カードも通帳も持っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 父が電話可能で本人資料なしと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: My father is at home and can speak by phone. I only came to ask after work. I have neither the card nor the passbook.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your father can speak by phone and that you have none of his account documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この場でお父様本人の手続きを済ませたとは扱えません。本人から担当へ連絡する方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We cannot treat your father's own procedure as completed here. We will explain how he can contact the staff himself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 本人へつなぐ番号をもらえますか。私の名前ではなく父の名前で相談するよう、父へ説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 父本人から連絡する番号を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Could you give me the number for him to call? I will explain that he should ask under his own name, not mine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for the number your father should contact himself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの案内です。紛失に気付いた時刻や、見覚えのない利用についても本人からお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here are the instructions. He should also tell us when he noticed the loss and about any unfamiliar transactions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 父は今朝気付いたと言っていました。ただ、利用の有無は私には分からないので父が確認して話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 紛失認知時刻と利用情報の不明を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: He said he noticed this morning. However, I do not know whether the card was used, so he will check and explain himself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Separate the time the loss was noticed from unknown transaction information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 暗証番号をこちらの窓口でお子様が聞き出す必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: There is no need for you, as his child, to find out his PIN at this desk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 番号は父自身が管理したままにします。案内を持ち帰る前に電話して、本人からの連絡を急いでもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 父の暗証番号を尋ねず本人連絡を促す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: My father will keep managing his PIN himself. Before taking the instructions home, I will call him and urge him to contact you promptly.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Do not ask for your father's PIN; encourage him to contact the staff himself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、ご本人へ案内をお渡しください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please pass these instructions to him. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 商品についてのご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to discuss a product, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日買った冷凍野菜の袋に、小さな穴がありました。調理する前に見つけたので、まだ食べていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 冷凍野菜袋の穴と未調理未喫食を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: There was a small hole in the bag of frozen vegetables I bought yesterday. I found it before cooking, so I have not eaten any yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report a hole in a frozen vegetable bag and say you have neither cooked nor eaten it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 袋を開けたり、別の容器へ移したりしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you opened the bag or moved the contents to another container?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 開けていません。外袋はそのままです。穴が店にいた時からあったかは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未開封と穴発生時点不明を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have not opened it. The outer packaging is unchanged. I do not know whether the hole was there while I was in the store.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say it is unopened and you do not know when the hole appeared. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当者が状態と購入記録を確認します。商品はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The staff will check the condition and purchase record. Have you brought the product?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 持っています。家では冷凍庫に入れていましたが、今は保冷袋で運びました。購入時のレシートもあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 保管持参状態とレシートを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I kept it in the freezer at home and brought it here in an insulated bag. I also have the receipt from the purchase.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe how you stored and transported it and show the receipt. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらで確認するまで、商品は保冷袋のままでお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please keep the product in the insulated bag until we check it here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。穴のある所を指せますが、自分でテープを貼って塞ぐことはしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 穴位置とテープ未使用を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I can point out the hole, but I have not put tape over it myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain the location of the hole and that you have not taped it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認後に対応をご案内します。交換などのご希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will explain what can be done after checking. Would you like an exchange or another response?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: できれば交換を希望します。ただ、同じ商品を今食べてよいかという判断ではなく、この購入品の対応を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 交換希望と相談対象を購入品へ限定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I would prefer an exchange if possible. However, I want to ask what can be done about this purchase, rather than get a decision on whether I can eat the same product now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Request an exchange and limit your question to handling the purchased item. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当者へ引き継ぎます。それでは、少々お待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass this to the staff. Please wait a moment. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 観察会の記録をお持ちになったのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have brought your records for the observation event, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 葉の写真を三枚持ってきました。でも、二枚には日付を書き忘れました。今日の記録と一緒に出してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 日付抜け写真を当日記録へ混ぜる可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I brought three photos of leaves. But I forgot to put dates on two of them. Can I submit them together with today's record?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may mix undated photos into today's record. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 撮影日が分かる物と、不明な物を分けてください。端末の情報で日付を確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please separate those with known shooting dates from those with unknown dates. Can you check the dates in your device's information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一枚は昨日の夕方と分かりました。もう一枚は友達からもらった画像で、日付が表示されていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 端末判明分と友人提供不明分を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I found that one was taken yesterday evening. The other is an image a friend gave me, and no date is displayed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the date confirmed on the device from the undated image your friend provided. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: もらった画像を、ご自身の今日の観察として記録しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please do not record an image you received as your own observation today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分で撮った二枚だけを記録に使います。友達の画像は参考に見せてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人記録を二枚へ限定し参考提示を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will use only the two photos I took myself for my record. May I show my friend's image as a reference?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Limit your own record to two photos and ask to show the other as a reference. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 撮影者と日付不明を明示して、担当へお見せください。同じ植物かも、写真だけでは決められません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please show it to the staff with the photographer and unknown date clearly stated. Photos alone cannot establish whether it is the same plant either.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友達の名前を伝え、比較用と説明します。今日撮った葉には、実際に見た場所も書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 撮影者不明日付と実見場所を明示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will give my friend's name and explain that it is for comparison. For the leaf I photographed today, I will also write where I actually saw it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Clearly state the photographer, unknown date, and place actually observed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今日の観察場所は、立入可能な道沿いでしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Was today's observation location beside a path where entry is permitted?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、園路から撮りました。花壇へ入っていません。場所は橋手前の案内札の横と記します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 園路からの撮影と案内札横の場所を記す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, I took it from the park path. I did not enter the flowerbed. I will write the location as beside the sign before the bridge.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Record that you photographed from the path and identify the location beside the sign. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 記録の違いが分かるようになりましたね。それでは、観察会をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: The differences between the records are clear now. Enjoy the observation event.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どちらまでの切符をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Where would you like a ticket to?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 明日、友人に会いに青丘へ行きます。一泊するかまだ決めていませんが、往復で買いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 宿泊未定で往復購入を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am going to Aooka tomorrow to see a friend. I have not decided whether to stay overnight, but I want to buy a return ticket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about a return ticket when your overnight stay is undecided. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 帰る日によって使える条件が違いますので、先にご予定を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: The conditions depend on the return date, so I will ask about your plans first.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 明日帰るか、あさって帰るか、友人の仕事が終わってから決まります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 復路日が友人の勤務後に決まると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Whether I return tomorrow or the day after will be decided after my friend finishes work.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your return date will be decided after your friend's work. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの往復券は帰りの日も指定していただきます。未定のまま同日帰りと記入することはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: For this return ticket, you must specify the return date too. We cannot enter a same-day return while the date remains undecided.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 安くなると思って往復と言いましたが、間違った日を決めるのは困ります。まず行きだけ購入できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 誤った帰り日を選ばず往路のみ尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I said return because I thought it would be cheaper, but choosing an incorrect date would be a problem. Can I buy only the outward ticket first?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Avoid choosing a false return date and ask for only an outward ticket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。帰りは決まってから別に購入できます。帰りの列車の予約まで確保するものではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. You can buy the return separately after deciding. This does not secure a reservation on a return train.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 帰りの席まで取れたとは考えません。友人と宿泊を決めた後に、復路の列車と購入方法を調べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 復路席未確保を理解して後日検討する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not assume I have a return seat. After deciding with my friend whether to stay overnight, I will check the return trains and how to buy a ticket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Acknowledge that a return seat is not secured and decide to consider it later. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 行きは明日の午前を希望されていますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: You would like to go tomorrow morning, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、午前中に着きたいです。今日は往路の日時と区間だけを確認し、その分を買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 午前到着希望と往路だけの購入を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, I would like to arrive in the morning. Today I will check only the outward date, time, and route, and buy that part.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you want to arrive in the morning and decide to buy only the outward journey. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、往路の候補をご案内します。よいお出掛けを。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will show you the outward options. Have a pleasant trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通知のどの部分を確認したいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which part of the notice would you like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 封筒は私宛てなのに、中の紙の上には父の名前があります。父の通知を間違えて送られたのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 封筒本人宛と紙父名の相違を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: The envelope is addressed to me, but the top of the paper inside has my father's name. Was my father's notice sent to me by mistake?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the difference between your name on the envelope and your father's name on the paper. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 名前だけでは決められません。欄の見出しを一緒に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: We cannot decide from the names alone. Let us check the field headings together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 父の名前の上には「世帯の代表者」とあります。下の対象者の欄には、私の名前がありました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 見出しから代表者父と対象者本人を読み分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Above my father's name it says household representative. In the subject-person field below, I found my name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Use the headings to distinguish your father as representative from yourself as the subject. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この通知では代表者と対象者を別に表示しています。ご相談は、ご自身の対象者欄についてですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: This notice lists the representative and the subject separately. Your question concerns your own subject-person section, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。父に全部任せようとしていましたが、私に必要な確認もあると分かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 父任せを改め本人の確認必要を理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I was about to leave everything to my father, but I now understand there are things I need to check too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Stop leaving everything to your father and acknowledge the need for your own checks. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 通知の担当窓口へ、対象者としての内容を確認できます。通知全体をお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can ask the responsible desk about the contents relating to you as the subject. Please bring the whole notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 父の名前がある所を切り取らず、そのまま持っていきます。父本人の相談を私がしているのではないと説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通知を切らず本人相談として持参する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will bring it unchanged without cutting off the part with my father's name. I will explain that I am not asking on his behalf.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Bring the uncut notice and explain that this is your own inquiry. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 通知に返信の期限があるかもご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also check whether the notice has a reply deadline.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 右下に期限があります。誰が対象か分かったので、今度は担当へ、私が返す書類と期限を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 返信期限と本人の提出書類を担当へ確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: There is a deadline at the bottom right. Now that I know who it concerns, I will ask the staff which documents I must return and by when.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check your reply deadline and required documents with the staff. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、担当窓口へご案内します。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will direct you to the responsible desk. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 初めてのご受診として受付されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you registering as a first-time patient?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ここで子どもの頃に診てもらったかもしれません。結婚前の名前だったので、今の名前だけでは分からないと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 幼少時受診の可能性と旧姓を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I may have been seen here as a child. It was under my name before marriage, so I think my current name alone will not identify the record.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain a possible childhood visit and your former surname. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 以前の診察券はお持ちでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have your previous patient card?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 持っていません。実家を探しましたが見つからず、受診した年も正確には覚えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 古券なしと受診年不明を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. I searched at my family home but could not find it, and I do not remember the exact year I visited either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you lack the old card and do not know the year of the visit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご本人の確認資料と、以前のお名前を伺います。記録の有無は確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will ask for your identification documents and former name. We need to check whether any records exist.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今の資料はこちらです。前の姓は別紙に書きます。名字が違うから別人、と決めないで確認してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 現本人資料と旧姓で記録照合を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here are my current documents. I will write my previous surname on another sheet. Could you check rather than conclude I am a different person because the surname differs?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request a record check using your current identification and former surname. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当へ確認します。古い記録が見つかるとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will ask the staff to check. The old records may not be found.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。見つからなくても受診の相談は続けたいです。昔の病名は覚えていないので推測で書きません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 記録未発見を受け入れ病名を推測しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. Even if they are not found, I still want to discuss being seen. I do not remember the old diagnosis, so I will not write a guess.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Accept that records may not be found and do not guess past diagnoses. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 新しく伺う現在の症状は、今回の問診票へお書きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please write your current symptoms on this visit's questionnaire.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今の症状を書きます。過去の名前と受診の可能性は受付へ伝え、今日の問診とは分けて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現在問診と旧名受診歴照会を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will write my current symptoms. I will tell reception about my former name and possible visit, and check that separately from today's questionnaire.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Separate today's questionnaire from inquiries about your former name and past visit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、担当へ引き継ぎます。お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will pass this to the staff. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらのイヤホンを拾われたのですね。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 公園の出口で拾いました。持ち主の名前が分かるかと思いましたが、自分の電話にはつないでいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 片耳イヤホン拾得と電話未接続を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I found it at the park exit. I wondered whether I could find the owner's name, but I have not connected it to my own phone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report finding a single earphone and not connecting it to your phone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: そのままお預かりします。ケースも一緒に落ちていましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will take it as it is. Was the case there too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ケースはありません。片方だけで、右と書いてある所が見えます。もう一つは探していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ケースなし右片耳と追加探索なしを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: There is no case. It is just one side, and I can see where it says right. I have not looked for the other one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that it is the right earphone without a case and you did not search further. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 拾った時刻と、落ちていた場所を詳しく教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell me when you found it and exactly where it was lying.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 午後四時ごろ、出口のベンチの下でした。通路から手を伸ばして拾える位置でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 時刻とベンチ下の拾得位置を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Around four in the afternoon, under the bench at the exit. I could reach it from the path.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the time and the position under the bench where you found it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 持ち主らしい方が近くにいましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Was anyone who seemed to be the owner nearby?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 近くの二人に忘れ物か尋ねましたが、違うと言われました。その方たちへ物は渡していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 周囲への照会と未引渡しを述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I asked two people nearby whether they had lost it, but they said no. I did not give it to them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Describe asking nearby people and not handing it over. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ここまで運ぶ間に、充電や操作はされましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Did you charge it or operate it while bringing it here?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 何もしていません。小袋に入れて持ってきました。状態を変えずにこちらへお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未操作未充電で現状引渡しを行う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I did nothing to it. I brought it in a small bag. I will hand it over here without changing its condition.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Hand it over unchanged without operating or charging it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お届けありがとうございました。それでは、拾得のお手続きを伺います。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for bringing it in. Now we will take the details for the found-property procedure. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 郵便物の宛先についてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to discuss the address on a postal item?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 引っ越し後の手紙が一通だけ前の家へ届きました。転居の手続きだけでなく、送り主の住所も確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 前住所へ届いた一通と差出人住所確認を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: One letter after my move arrived at my old home. I would like to check not only the forwarding procedure but also the address the sender used.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about one letter delivered to your old address and checking the sender's address information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その手紙の宛先に、今の住所は書かれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Does the letter's destination include your current address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 番地は新しい住所ですが、建物名は前の家のものです。叔父が二つの住所を混ぜて書いたようです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 新番地と旧建物名が混在していると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: The street number is the new address, but the building name is my old home's. My uncle seems to have mixed the two addresses.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the mixture of the new street number and old building name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その記載の原因や取扱結果は確認が必要です。送り主へ正しい住所を伝えられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: The reason for that wording and the handling outcome need checking. Can you tell the sender your correct address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 叔父へ番地から部屋番号まで一続きで送ります。番地だけを直すよう頼むと、古い建物名が残ってしまいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 完全な新住所を叔父へ送る計画を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will send my uncle the whole address, from street number to room number. If I ask him to correct only the street number, the old building name will remain.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe your plan to send your uncle the complete new address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 転居手続きの状況も担当へ確認できますが、それで送り主の住所帳が書き換わるわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff can also check the forwarding procedure's status, but that does not rewrite the sender's address book.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: そこは別なのですね。叔父の住所帳から古い住所を消して、新しい住所を登録してもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 転居手続きと叔父住所帳訂正を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Those are separate, then. I will ask my uncle to delete the old address from his address book and register the new one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish the forwarding procedure from correction of your uncle's address book. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 手元の手紙は、ご自身宛てと分かる物でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Can you tell that the letter you have is addressed to you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、私宛てです。封筒を持って担当へ状況を確認し、次回から同じ書き間違いをしないよう叔父へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人宛封筒で照会し書き間違い防止を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, it is for me. I will take the envelope to the staff to check what happened and tell my uncle how to avoid the same address error next time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Inquire using the envelope addressed to you and explain how to prevent the writing error. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、封筒と一緒に担当へおつなぎします。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will connect you with the staff along with the envelope. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 登録する電話番号の変更でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to change your registered telephone number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 古い携帯を解約しました。新しい番号がまだないので、兄の番号を一時的に登録しようと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未契約の本人番号の代わりに兄番号を提案する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I cancelled my old mobile contract. I do not have a new number yet, so I am thinking of temporarily registering my older brother's number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Suggest your brother's number in place of your not-yet-contracted number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 口座についての連絡がその番号へ届くことがあります。ご自身が使う番号として登録できるか、条件の確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Account-related communications may go to that number. We need to check the conditions for registering it as a number you use yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 兄にはまだ頼んでいません。兄の電話へ銀行の連絡が行くなら、勝手に書くのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 兄未承諾と連絡内容のため無断登録をやめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have not asked my brother yet. If bank communications will go to his phone, I will not write it down without permission.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say your brother has not consented and stop registering his number without permission because of the communications. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 新しい番号を取得する予定はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Are you planning to get a new number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 来週、自分の携帯を契約します。それまで連絡先がない状況を、担当に相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 来週契約まで連絡先なしを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will get my own mobile contract next week. I would like to ask the staff about having no contact number until then.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about having no contact number until your contract next week. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 現在のご登録と手続き状況を確認します。ほかの連絡方法も、担当が条件をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check your current registration and procedure status. The staff will also explain conditions for other ways to contact you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 使える方法を確認してから選びます。家族だから同じ扱いだと思わず、自分が受け取れる連絡先にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族番号と本人受取方法を区別し条件確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will choose after checking which methods I can use. I will not assume family members are treated the same; I will choose contact details where I can receive messages myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish a family member's number from your own receipt of communications and check the conditions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 新しい番号が決まった時にも、あらためて変更手続きをお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please complete another change procedure when your new number is decided.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 契約後は番号を記録して来ます。今日、兄の番号へ変更を済ませたということにはしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 契約後変更と今日の変更未実施を明確にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will note the number and bring it after signing the contract. Please do not treat today as having completed a change to my brother's number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Clarify that you will change it after the contract and no change has been made today. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、連絡先未定のご相談として担当へ引き継ぎます。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Then I will refer this to the staff as a consultation about an undecided contact number. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの果物の売場について、ご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about this fruit section?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子どもが先ほど小さく切った物を頂きました。買った袋には切った物が入っていないのですが、別に受け取るのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 試食と購入袋内の形の違いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: My child was given a small cut piece just now. The bag we bought has no cut pieces inside. Do we receive those separately?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the difference between the sample and the form of the fruit in your purchase. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 小さい物は試食用です。販売する袋には、切っていない果物が二つ入っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The small pieces are for tasting. The bag for sale contains two uncut fruits.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 試食は商品の形を見せるのではなく、味を試すためだったのですね。子どもは切った状態で買えると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 試食用途と子どもの期待の違いを述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: So the sample was to try the taste, rather than show how the product comes. My child thought we could buy it already cut.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the difference between the sample's purpose and your child's expectation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 切った物を買いたい場合は、別のカット果物の売場になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: If you want to buy cut fruit, it is in a separate cut-fruit section.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家で切れるので、今の袋のままにします。子どもには家で食べる前に切ると説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家で切るため現購入品を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: We can cut it at home, so I will keep this bag as it is. I will tell my child we will cut it before eating at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose your current purchase because you can cut it at home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 袋の果物に不具合があったというご相談ではありませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: So your question is not about a problem with the fruit in the bag, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、袋の内容には問題ありません。試食と販売品を同じ物だと取り違えて質問しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 不具合なしと質問理由を明確にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, there is no problem with the contents. I asked because I confused the sample with the product for sale.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Clarify that there is no defect and explain why you asked. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ほかに購入する物はございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Is there anything else you would like to buy?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日はこの二つ入りだけです。試食をもう一度もらって持ち帰ることはせず、買った袋を持って帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二個袋購入と試食持帰りをしない判断を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Just this bag of two today. I will not ask for another sample to take home; I will take home the bag I bought.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you are buying the bag of two and will not take samples home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、果物をお楽しみください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then enjoy your fruit. Thank you.
